svg.text: East branch · revised: burnable hedge, cow blockade and key-runner chase · 48 × 40 tiles
PROPOSED LAYOUT • Top-down • 32px logical tiles • Plan only — not implemented
Coco fires at the one dry, marked bush.
It burns away and stays open.
Other hedges stay solid, even in Flight.
The cow blocks the full forward passage.
Coco casts Black Hole from the side bay.
The impact vortex pulls it sideways; Sieg
passes through the newly cleared space.
Coco slows the fast runner; Sieg sprints
after it and holds E to tag / take the key.
Flees either hero; picks safe escape branches.
Runner resists Black Hole; no ranged key grab.
Key enters the shared inventory once.
04 K · KEY OPENS THE CHEST GATE
Use the shared key on gate K.
Open the chest for Enchanted Hedge Shears.
Key use + gate opening is one transaction.
Cow parking / burned hedge persist on retry.
Five encounter monsters: M = Mossling ×2; W = Cinder Wisp ×2; I = Iron Sentinel ×1. Key runner is separate.
Runner flees both heroes instead of circling. Coordinate Slow Time + Super Speed, then hold E to tag.
Sentinel uses its existing starter sprite; attacks remain unimplemented. Cow remains harmless and immune to damage.
Retry: reset only the uncaught runner, never a collected key. No cow teleport, friendly damage, or key duplication.
Gold: Sieg / physical • Purple: Coco / magic • Cyan: mechanism / return • Dashed: link or conditional access
